name: Coding agents
description: The Agents panel: every coding agent on every machine in one list (terminals, chats, cloud sessions), the ones that need you first. And one set of blocks for every coding agent: its plan's limits, its sessions, its usage by day, project and model, and one project's. A block's `agent:` names whose (claude-code, codex...): each agent's plugin draws them, read from that agent's own files, and with that plugin off its blocks are off too.

group.label: Group agents by
group.description: the Agents panel's and tab's agents under a heading each: by where they stand, the repository or folder they work in, the machine they run on, or the account they run in (the panel's menu sets it too)

sort.label: Sort agents by
sort.description: status: the ones that need you first, then the ones working, then the ones done; recent: the latest first

hide.label: Hidden kinds
hide.description: the kinds of agents the Agents panel and tab leave out: the ones in terminals, in chats or in the cloud

fold.label: Fold finished agents
fold.description: how long an agent done and read, with nothing for you and no tab open, stays in the Agents and Terminals panels before it folds under Earlier; never keeps every one listed

agent-limits.description: an agent's plan limits (the session, the week, a month's included usage): how much is used and when each renews
agent-limits.live: the agent's account, asked through its CLI or its own files on the machine the server runs on

account.description: one account's (its id, like default or personal); all of them when left out
